title: The Toast Popper Upper doesn't Pop high enough!
text:
The Toast Popper Upper doesn't Pop high enough!. I have not had a toaster that did not pop high enough. Well, I found one! The toaster is simple to use and using bagels quite often, you just need to adjust the temperature level FOR the bagel. It takes time to find out what works. I do have mini bagels too and those need an adjustment level also. The SLOTS are wide enough, no problem there. But, if you use small breads, like French Breads, the bread will not even reach the top ...... to pop. I have even turned the toaster upside down to release some toast!

The toaster is simple, knob adjustment and a bagel button. Different breads and bagels may take a different adjustment level, but keep experimenting to see what works best. So, my only serious fault right now is that the Popper doesn't Pop high enough. Grab the toast carefully!
